style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

FreegyptAs Egypt, go from puppet to a free nation using the autonomy system.
Is Egypt Reached Colony Status Reached Dominion Status Reached Freedom Status

Start as the United Kingdom and build up Egypt as much as possible. Once completely full of military factories, release Egypt as a puppet (check "Play as" when the checkbox appears). Increase your autonomy in any way possible: lend lease (trains and convoys are excellent), continuous focus and attaché.

Better than the Szent IstvánAs Hungary, have Miklos Horthy as a Naval commander and build a battleship.
Has the unit leader Miklos Horthy Has at least 1 Battleship

With Götterdämmerung, you must complete the End the Regency to get Horthy as an advisor. Otherwise, you must complete Invite the Habsburg Prince. After that, you can go for any path under Reinstate the Pragmatic Sanction of 1713 to get wargoals on Yugoslavia or Romania. Build up your industry and army, conquer either one, research and deploy a battleship and assign Horthy to that fleet.

The Balkan Powder KegAs Yugoslavia, start the Second World War (i.e. be part of either the Axis or the Allies and at war with the other faction in a war you started).
Declared war on Axis or Allies while in either Axis or Allies

Choose fascist demagogue as your first Political Power spending, turn fascist (skip civil war option), complete Invite German Military Mission and join the Axis. Justify and declare war on the UK. If playing on historical, signing the Tripartite pact will cause a civil war. So just flip via decision and join the axis manually.
En Svensk TigerAs Sweden, acquire a production license for a Tiger or Tiger II tank from Germany.
Is licensing from ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧: Heavy Tank II (Panzerkampfwagen VI Tiger) Heavy Tank III (Panzerkampfwagen Tiger Ausf. B) Improved Heavy Tank Chassis Advanced Heavy Tank Chassis
Heavy Tank II (Panzerkampfwagen VI Tiger) Heavy Tank III (Panzerkampfwagen Tiger Ausf. B) Improved Heavy Tank Chassis Advanced Heavy Tank Chassis
Heavy Tank III (Panzerkampfwagen Tiger Ausf. B)

Choose the fascist demagogue as your first advisor and turn fascist. Avoid civil war if possible. Join the Axis and help them in their wars. Germany has to survive until they research Tiger tank - at least late 1943. Note: Due to a bug, this achievement cannot be obtained with the No Step Back enabled, because Germany never progresses beyond "Basic Heavy Tank", no matter how long you wait.
Lethal StraightHave a production license from at least 5 of the 7 major powers.
Is licensing from 5 of the below: United Kingdom Germany United States Soviet Union Japan France Italy
United Kingdom Germany United States Soviet Union Japan France Italy

It is recommended to play as a non-aligned nation to avoid the diplomatic penalty from different ideology which may block the “Request License Production” option. Improve relations with five of the seven major powers then license the basic infantry weapons. (Researching the next level of infantry equipment also works, as even major nations have few problems with licensing outdated equipment). With La Résistance, you can use an agent and assign him to put diplomatic pressure on majors as well.

Romance of the Three KingdomsAs China, puppet and then annex Yunnan and Guangxi Clique.
Integrated the Guanxi Clique through making them a puppet Integrated Yunnan through making them a puppet
Integrated the Guanxi Clique through making them a puppet
Integrated Yunnan through making them a puppet

Play on non-historical and ensure Japan goes for Support the Kodoha Faction. Take Subjugate the Warlords. If they do not accept peacefully, use your war goals to puppet them by force. Complete the series of "Integrate the Warlords" decisions which appear after Guangxi Clique and Yunnan are puppetted. Alternatively, defeat them the old-fashioned way (possibly after taking One China Policy focus) and then reduce their autonomy by building stuff (including border-to-border level 5 forts and supply depots) on their territories and/or lend-leasing supplies to them. The achievement can even be done by annexing them in a war, releasing them as puppets, and then reintegrating them (in case "puppet" is not an available option in the peace conference.)
